title: code.verify-resolutions output
description: This round hands the session back with `next: {kind:"self-round"}` rather than resolving the step, so it emits no step output. Its result is the `resolutions` artifact: one line per comment from `postedReview`, in the same order, each `addressed` | `not-addressed` | `unclear` plus the evidence commit and hunk. `code.submit-pr-verdict` derives the verdict from it — any `not-addressed` blocks an APPROVE.
